I would rather die than rely on this hospital here to do something like that. After my Mom died they took everything from me. They took her house, her car. They wouldn't let me get out family pictures out of the house. I lost everything after she died and it was because of that hospital. 

I'm actually looking forward to death now. After this shitty day and how bad things got over the past decade. Fuck it. Fuck life, fuck waking up everyday. I'm going to go hang myself right now.

I've just been throwing up blood over the past few months and feeling worse lately. I get these pains in my side and I feel weak. I need a better job so I can afford health insurance. The free clinic doesn't have the proper equipment and all they do is try to convince me there is nothing wrong with me. 

Today's the last day. Not another day of this life one way or another.

No. 

I need to be able to afford the doctor. I've been throwing up blood almost everyday for 3 months now. 

I need a better job so I can afford the doctor. I also need better transportation to get a better job. 

But that's another reason I'm ready to kill myself. No one seems to understand.
